theorems.statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))), (∀ K : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))) (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ ∧ HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P θ) → ∃ R : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable n R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0) → ApproximateTangentCharacterization → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))), (∀ K : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → MeasurableSet S → μ Sᶜ = 0 → (∀ x ∈ S, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1) → CountablyRectifiable n S ∧ μ = (μHE[n] : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ))).restrict S
